title: Dental PPO Plans Individual-Market Monthly Premium Rates
content:
Monthly individual-market premium rates for the Dental PPO Plans, in US dollars per month, by coverage tier.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member only | 18.94 | 27.36 | 34.12 | 41.58 | 52.87 | 63.45 |
| Member and spouse | 36.10 | 53.18 | 66.40 | 80.92 | 102.66 | 123.12 |
| Member and children | 38.62 | 57.04 | 71.15 | 86.71 | 110.03 | 131.94 |
| Family | 58.47 | 86.29 | 107.66 | 131.17 | 166.40 | 199.55 |

### Reading example
A hypothetical subscriber with one child on Classic 1250 in the individual market is billed at the member-and-children rate, 71.15 per month; adding a spouse moves the account to the family rate, 107.66 per month.
